messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT (P1) — /v1/generate: queue latency elevated in us-east-1. P95 ~2.3s (baseline 500ms). error rate ~5% over 3m. triggering oncall: Alice H
Alice H: looking... thanks. putting myself as responder. can someone grab runtime? @Bob R @Eli Runtime
Bob R: on it. I see persistent inflight saturation on gpu-pool-us-east-1a, tenant slice skewed by a few heavy tenants. probable cause: new streaming client spike + long seqs.
Carol SRE: fyi, KPIs: token throughput OK, but queue length and per-request wall time ticking. we've got a handful of big requests holding KV caches open.
Alice H: initial mitigation options? toggle feature, reduce max_inflight, shedding tiers?
Bob R: plan: 1) soft-shed free/anon to 3rps per-tenant 2) reduce max_inflight for shared pool from 120 -> 60 to force shedding earlier 3) disable new streaming protocol flag (stream_proto_v2) for hosted temporarily 4) bump quota for top paying tenants if impacted.
Eli Runtime: +1 on reducing max_inflight. will apply in config manager. doing it per-pool to avoid global blast.
Dave CS: prepping customer comms. which tenants are impacted most? send list and I’ll ping them. we should offer temporary quota bump or routing to dedicated if needed.
Bob R: commands:
```
# set max inflight for pool
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
  https://admin.redwood.local/api/pools/us-east-1a/config
  -d '{"max_inflight":60}'
# disable feature flag
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
  https://admin.redwood.local/api/flags/stream_proto_v2 -d '{"enabled":false}'
```
Alice H: do the quota mapping too? Carol, can you craft a soft-shed map for free/anon?
Carol SRE: yes. pushing a mapping that drops free/anon to token rate 3rps and routes heavy tenants to priority lanes (no shed). payload: `{"tier":"free","max_rps":3}`. applying now.
Carol SRE: applied soft-shed mapping. incident-bot logged.
incident-bot: action logged: soft-shed applied by Carol SRE at 1745678928
Eli Runtime: applying max_inflight change now.
Eli Runtime: done — pool us-east-1a max_inflight=60. Observability: queue length halved within 30s, p95 dropped to ~1.1s.
Bob R: disabling feature flag now.
Bob R: stream_proto_v2 disabled. rolling back client-side behavior expected.
Alice H: good. monitoring for errors on clients that depended on v2. can we throttle retries so we don't get retry storm?
Bob R: added temporary per-tenant retry cap = 2. will keep for 10m.
Dave CS: grabbing affected tenant list and drafting outbound. will send a short note: why, what we did, ETA to return to normal, and contact.
Alice H: customer impact note: Hosted customers saw degraded latency and some 500s for long-seq workloads. No data loss. mitigations applied: soft-shed free tier, reduced pool inflight, disabled streaming v2, limited retries. Next check in 10m.
Carol SRE: metrics 3m after actions: p95 850ms, error rate 0.8%. queue depth normalized.
incident-bot: PAGING: +1 to oncall rotation for follow-up (postmortem prep).
Bob R: will keep an eye for any cascading backpressure. considering a longer-term change: adaptive max_inflight based on per-tenant seq-length histogram.
Alice H: agree. Eli/Bob, please open follow-up ticket with suggested rollout plan and perf tests. Carol, please add mitigation snapshot to the incident timeline. Dave, send comms when ready.
Dave CS: sending comms now. short note linked. cc: customer success leads.
Alice H: thanks team. marking mitigation stable for now. will hand to next oncall for 30m watch and then start RCA if stable. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated (partial). timeline entry created at 1745678965
